Name: (AT) Maximalism
Author: smallcopper
Description:
Here it is! 

Maximalism, all in one place again, for Alternative Textures. This is for those who don't want the CP versions. I'll continue to update this if/when further CP collections are released -- keep an eye out. 

Install as usual, buy the Paint Bucket from Robin or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to find the textures. The vanilla items that are retextured are all shown in the image on this page. 

As always, let me know if anything is going wrong, and do drop me a comment if you're looking for any particular items used in the screenshots as I (predictably) don't keep an organised mod list :')

Have fun and happy cluttering. :]

Manifest.Name: Smallcopper's Maximalism for AT
Manifest.Description: Adds a collection of decorative clutter via Alternative Textures.
